title: Viridian Crystal
summary: An Underdark ingredient for Diluted Oil of Sharpness.

fields.Extraction: Grind three Viridian Crystals into Salts of Viridian Crystal.
fields.Recipe: Combine the Salts with any Vitriol to make Diluted Oil of Sharpness.
fields.Acquisition: Find in the Underdark or buy from Derryth Bonecloak.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
